Game Overview

At its heart, Cut for Cat is a puzzle game about slice through ropes and master physics in Cut for Cat. Strategically navigate swinging platforms and portals to deliver treats to a hungry feline. Each level challenges your problem-solving skills as you aim to collect bonus stars with minimal cuts. Can you keep the cat happily fed?
